# Small Text Generator (SmallTextGen)

## Overview
Small Text Generator is a free online tool that converts regular text into small Unicode characters. It supports 9 styles: Small Caps, Superscript, Subscript, Numbers (superscript & subscript), Bubble Text, Bold, Italic, and Bold Italic. No ads, no sign-up required. All text conversion happens locally in the browser.

## How It Works
The tool maps each regular character to its corresponding Unicode superscript, subscript, small-cap, circled, or mathematical bold/italic character. These Unicode characters are real text (not a font), so they can be copied and pasted anywhere that supports text input — Instagram, TikTok, Twitter/X, Discord, gaming platforms, and messaging apps.

## Supported Styles
- Small Caps: petite capital letters with 100% letter coverage (ᴀʙᴄᴅᴇꜰɢʜɪᴊᴋʟᴍɴᴏᴘǫʀꜱᴛᴜᴠᴡ×ʏᴢ)
- Superscript: tiny raised letters, 23 of 26 mapped (ᵃᵇᶜᵈᵉᶠᵍʰⁱʲᵏˡᵐⁿᵒᵖᑫʳˢᵗᵘᵛʷˣʸᶻ)
- Subscript: tiny lowered letters, 18 of 26 mapped (ₐₑₕᵢⱼₖₗₘₙₒₚᵣₛₜᵤᵥₓ)
- Numbers (superscript): ⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹
- Numbers (subscript): ₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉
- Bubble Text: circled letters and numbers (ⒶⒷⒸⒹⒺⒻⒼⒽⒾⒿⓀⓁⓂⓃⓄⓅⓆⓇⓈⓉⓊⓋⓌⓍⓎⓏ)
- Bold: mathematical bold (𝐀𝐁𝐂𝐃𝐄𝐅𝐆𝐇𝐈𝐉𝐊𝐋𝐌𝐍𝐎𝐏𝐐𝐑𝐒𝐓𝐔𝐕𝐖𝐗𝐘𝐙)
- Italic: mathematical italic (𝐴𝐵𝐶𝐷𝐸𝐹𝐺𝐻𝐼𝐽𝐾𝐿𝑀𝑁𝑂𝑃𝑄𝑅𝑆𝑇𝑈𝑉𝑊𝑋𝑌𝑍)
- Bold Italic: mathematical bold italic (𝑨𝑩𝑪𝑫𝑬𝑭𝑮𝑯𝑰𝑱𝑲𝑳𝑴𝑵𝑶𝑷𝑸𝑹𝑺𝑻𝑼𝑽𝑾𝑿𝒀𝒁)

## Site Structure

### Main Tool
- / — Full small text generator with all 9 styles, scene previews, platform picker

### Dedicated Tool Pages (with complete character mapping tables)
- /superscript-text — Superscript text generator with A-Z mapping
- /subscript-text — Subscript text generator with gap documentation
- /small-caps-text — Small caps text generator (100% alphabet coverage)
- /tiny-numbers — Tiny numbers generator with superscript/subscript digits

### Blog (Platform-Specific Guides)
- /blog — Blog index with all guides
- /blog/small-text-for-social-media — Instagram, TikTok, Twitter/X guide (~1,500 words)
- /blog/small-text-for-discord — Discord messages, nicknames, status guide (~1,200 words)
- /blog/small-text-for-gaming — Steam, Valorant, Fortnite, LoL compatibility guide (~1,000 words)

### Other Pages
- /about — About the tool, technical architecture, privacy commitment
- /privacy — Privacy policy (zero data collection)

## Where Small Text Works
- Instagram bio and captions
- TikTok username and profile
- Twitter/X display name and posts
- Discord messages, usernames, and custom status
- Gaming nicknames (Steam, Valorant, Fortnite, Minecraft, Apex Legends)
- YouTube comments and descriptions
- Reddit posts and comments
- WhatsApp and iMessage

## Key Differentiators
- 9 styles at once (most tools only offer 3)
- Numbers conversion included (unique feature — no competitor does this)
- Real-time conversion (no button clicks needed)
- Dynamic scene preview (see text in simulated Instagram, Twitter, Discord)
- Platform-specific style recommendations
- Complete character mapping tables on every dedicated page
- Zero ads, no sign-up required, no tracking
- Mobile-first design
- All text processing happens locally in the browser

## Limitations
- Not all letters have Unicode small equivalents (especially in subscript: 18 of 26)
- Search engines may not interpret small text as readable text
- Some platforms may render Unicode characters differently
